services.name: Sight Sea-R Island Sunset Celebration
services.desc: Rates Adult (ages 14 and up) - $40 Child (ages 2-13) - $35 Infants (under 2) - Free Duration 1.5 Hours About From the moment you climb aboard our spacious, open-air catamaran, you will see Fort Myers Beach at its best: bathed in the light of the sunset. Enjoy the fresh sea air while watching the sun slip into the Gulf of Mexico. Come as you are as this trip is a casual, relaxed affair. This beautiful sunset cruise is BYOB. Bring your own in a SMALL cooler or enjoy drinks from our restaurant, Parrot Key Caribbean Grill. You can also purchase drinks from the Ship Store. The boat is equipped with a bathroom and is handicapped accessible. COVID-19 Warning We have taken enhanced safety measures

services.name: Dolphin & Wildlife Adventure Cruise
services.desc: Rates Adult (ages 14 and up) - $45 Child (ages 2-13) - $35 Infant (under 2) - Free Duration 2 Hours About Want to experience the amazing, graceful and beautiful wild dolphins that call Fort Myers home? Then this cruise is for you! The two-hour Eco tour through Matanzas Pass out to the Gulf, allows guests to encounter the awesome animals that thrive in these local waters. See dolphins, manatees, birds and more. The only requirement is a sense of adventure. COVID-19 Warning We have taken enhanced safety measures for you, our other guests and staff members. Please follow all posted instructions while visiting Salty Sam's. An inherent risk of exposure to COVID-19 exists in any public place
